teacher_info.introduction:
Hello! My name is Chris. 
I’m a professional bilingual translator. If you want to improve your Spanish, I'll be glad to help you! I have a sound grasp of all the grammatical structures and modes of speaking (imperative, subjunctive and indicative).

I’m a native Spanish speaker from Chile, currently living in Santiago.
As I've learnt English at university, I can perfectly understand the difficulties which you may encounter while studying a new language. I can provide you with useful advice for language learning. We can use various methods throughout our lessons. I am confident, very open-minded and resourceful. 

Soy traductor bilingüe y actualmente trabajo para el Departamento de Relaciones Internacionales de una Universidad. 

Como hispano hablante, sé lo difícil que significa dominar un idioma. Creo que para maximizar la efectividad del aprendizaje necesitas a un tutor capaz de conectarse contigo, ofrecerte lo que deseas y motivarte en cada lección para lograr tus objetivos.

Habiendo dicho lo anterior, me desempeñé como instructor en la milicia por ocho años. Eso me ha permito usar el liderazgo durante mis clases.

Qualifications & Experience

I hold a degree in bilingual translation English>Spanish awarded by University of Arturo Prat, Chile.

My students are from all over the world: Canada, Russia, Italy, USA, England, etc. I have teaching experience with students of different ages, levels and cultures.

Teaching Approach

I offer individual tailor-made lessons which allow my students to work on areas of particular interest or concern. Each lesson is prepared according to the student’s specific needs.
During my lessons I use different tools such as videos, songs, newspaper articles, etc. I always advise my students to work on all aspects of language skills: reading, writing, listening and conversation, with emphasis on speaking. Hopefully we can speak Spanish from the beginning!

I provide my students with all the material they will need during the lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginners / Let's get started!!
pro_course_detail.description:
Dear Student, 

Throughout this course, we will analyse some essential aspects and differences between English and Spanish as well as the way our brain works whilst acquiring another language. Before you set off, it’s important for you to know more details about the Spanish language, such as its background, a bit of its history and grammatical aspects (sounds, lexis, tenses, etc...) But don’t worry since I’ve prepared a great and enjoyable material! 

I look forward to seeing you soon! 
Best, 
Chris

pro_course_detail.title: Nivel Intermedio (¡Continúa ampliando tu potencial!)
pro_course_detail.description:
Dear Student, 
This course is aimed at learners who manage the basics of Spanish and are looking for strengthening their language skills, grammar & vocab, and fluency. 

During this course, we will focus on deeper knowledge of grammar and will analyse common contexts so that we can practise and produce Subjunctive Mood, Past tenses, and specific vocabulary. It is often said that Intermediate level slows down your learning process. Harmer claims that “students have already achieved a lot”, but don’t worry at all because my task is to do this simple and fun! 

Looking forward to starting right away! 

Best,
Chris

pro_course_detail.title: Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
Estimado estudiante, 
Este curso has sido planeado para estudiantes que están comenzando a aprender inglés o simplemente desean empezar desde el principio. 

Antes de comenzar tu aprendizaje, es necesario comprender el inglés desde una perspectiva académica y natural. Pues bien, comenzaremos con una introducción al inglés en la cual analizaremos diferencias y aspectos esenciales entre el español e inglés, así como también podremos revisar un poco de su historia e influencias lingüísticas. Además, hablaremos brevemente de cómo nuestro cerebro funciona al momento de ser expuesto a la adquisición de otra lengua.   

Lo anterior suena un poco pesado, pero no te preocupes ya que he preparado un material entretenido y fácil de comprender. 

Saludos cordiales, 
¡Te espero!

pro_course_detail.title: English all levels

pro_course_detail.title: (New) Inmersión en la cultura chilena / Si poh weón, ¿cachai?
pro_course_detail.description:
Estimado(a) estudiante: 

¿Deseas saber más sobre la cultura chilena o estás planeando en hacer un viaje a Chile? Pues, ¡no dudes en programar una lección en esta categoría! 

Yo soy un profesor nacido y crecido en Chile. A lo largo de mi experiencia de vida en el «país del vino», he tenido la oportunidad de hacer presentaciones dirigidas a extranjeros para proporcionales aspectos importantes de Chile, como por ej.: históricos y sociales, sobre la gastronomía y bebidas, idiosincrasia, jerga chilena, etc… 

¿Por qué aprender sobre Chile? 
Es un país que ofrece una diversidad de paisajes que varía desde el desierto de Atacama hasta los hielos de la Patagonia, ¿cachai? Asimismo, existen fenómenos lingüísticos muy curiosos, como la palabra «wea» que puede significar múltiples cosas. Mi dicho favorito es: «una wea es una wea, y otra wea … es otra wea totalmente diferente»
Bueno, si tienes alguna pregunta sobre cualquier wea, por favor, no dudes en avisarme. 

Saludos cordiales, 
Cris

pro_course_detail.title: FRENCH CONVERSATIONAL LESSON FOR KIDS / CONVERSATIONAL LESSON  FOR TWO OR MORE ADULTS
pro_course_detail.description:
FRENCH CONVERSATION FOR KIDS
Welcome to Our French Conversation for Kids Class!
This class is perfect for children aged 6 to 12 who are new to French or want to speak it better. 
What we'll do:
•	Encourage Communication: Help kids express themselves in French through simple dialogues and everyday topics.
•	Build Vocabulary: Learn basic words related to animals, colors, food, and hobbies.
•	Enhance Listening Skills: Play interactive games and sing songs to understand French better.
How we'll learn:
•	Role-Playing: Pretend to be different people and practice talking in French.
•	Storytelling: Listen to stories and talk about them in French.

Conversation Française pour Enfants
Bienvenue dans notre cours de conversation française pour enfants ! 
Ce cours est parfait pour les enfants de 6 à 12 ans qui débutent en français ou qui souhaitent améliorer leurs compétences en conversation
Ce que nous ferons :
•	Encourager la communication : Aider les enfants à s'exprimer en français par le biais de dialogues simples et de sujets du quotidien.
•	Enrichir le vocabulaire : Apprendre des mots de base liés aux animaux, aux couleurs, à la nourriture et aux loisirs.
•	Améliorer la compréhension orale : Jouer à des jeux interactifs et chanter des chansons pour mieux comprendre le français.
•	Contes : Écouter des histoires et en discuter en français.
•	Jeux de rôle : Se mettre à la place de différentes personnes et s'entraîner à parler français.

pro_course_detail.title: Language Essentials --All Levels/adults, teens (7+ of age)
pro_course_detail.description:
In general English, I have personalized resources  structured in different levels to cater to leaners with varying proficiency levels. Each level focuses on specific language skills, vocabulary, and grammar rules to help students develop their language skills in speaking, listening , reading, and writing. These courses are divided into different  levels based on the student. In the blog post, we will discuss the different levels of general English that   that will help you. Also, get ready to improve your knowledge of everyday  English and life events and learn the language.

Beginner (A1)
This is the starting level for learners who have little or no knowledge of the English language. It focuses on basic vocabulary and grammar rules, including sentence structure, verb tenses, pronouns, learn common phrases and expressions for daily use. For example, students at this level might learn how to introduce themselves, ask for directions, or order food at a restaurant.

Elementary (A2) 
At this level, students will learn to communicate in simple and basic English. This level is for learners who can understand and use basic English phrases and expressions. It builds on the vocabulary and grammar learned  at the beginner level and students will be able to construct more complex sentences. For example, students might learn how to describe their daily routine or talk about their hobbies and interests in proper sentences and include topics such as work, leisure, travel, and family.

Intermediate (B1) 
This General English level focuses on making students hold a conversation in English and understand more complex sentences. It covers topics such as expressing opinions, discussing current events, and giving presentations confidently. Students will also learn more advanced grammar and vocabulary, and will be able to read and understand more complex texts. 
Upper intermediate (B2)
This level is for learners who are comfortable with using English in various situations.

course_info.trial_description:
What to Expect in Your Trial Lesson
In our first session, we’ll set the foundation for your English learning journey by:

🔹 Exploring Your Learning Style – Are you a visual, auditory, or kinesthetic learner? I’ll assess your preferences and tailor the materials accordingly to make learning easier and more effective for you.

🔹 Presenting Class Materials – You’ll get an overview of the books, programs, and resources we’ll use to ensure a structured and engaging learning experience.

🔹 Mapping Out Your Progress – I’ll walk you through the topics we’ll cover over the semester and the level of English you can expect to achieve by the end of our lessons.

🔹 Understanding Our Class Activities – Expect fun and interactive exercises that will boost your confidence in English—no boring drills, just practical learning that keeps you engaged.

🔹 Assessing Your Current Level – To personalize your learning plan, we’ll complete a short test to determine your starting point and the best approach to help you improve efficiently.

📌 Tracking Your Progress (Without the Stress!) – Every now and then, we’ll have light, no-pressure quizzes to see how much you’ve improved. Think of them as friendly checkpoints rather than tests—no stress, just a way to celebrate your progress!

pro_course_detail.title: English A1 for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 Practice Real-Life Conversations – Whether it’s introducing yourself, ordering at a café, or expressing your ideas clearly, we’ll work on natural, everyday communication skills.

🔹 Boost Your Confidence – We’ll ease into speaking, listening, and writing exercises at your pace, so you feel comfortable and excited to improve.

🔹 Learn with Tailored Materials – Based on your learning style, I’ll provide the right mix of visual, audio, or interactive resources to make learning easier and more enjoyable for you.

🔹 Practice Basic Introductions – You’ll learn how to introduce yourself and others with simple sentences like:
“Hello, my name is…” / “I am from…” / “Nice to meet you!”
→ Exercise: Short role-play where you introduce yourself and ask a partner basic questions.

🔹 Master Essential Greetings & Common Phrases – From "Good morning!" to "See you later!", we’ll cover key expressions used in daily conversations.
→ Exercise: Matching activity where you pair greetings with their appropriate responses.

🔹 Build Simple Sentences – Learn the structure of basic sentences like "I am a student" or "She is from Spain."
→ Exercise: Fill in the blanks using "am / is / are" to complete sentences correctly.

🔹 Strengthen Your Listening Skills – You’ll listen to slow, clear dialogues and practice understanding key words.
→ Exercise: Listen to a short conversation and answer simple questions like "What is his name?" or "Where is she from?"

🔹 Set Your First Milestone – We’ll establish small, achievable goals so you can track your progress and feel accomplished every step of the way.

pro_course_detail.title: English A2 for Basic Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 A2 – Everyday Conversations Made Easy
Perfect for beginners ready to take the next step! You’ll improve your ability to express yourself in common situations and start forming more natural sentences.

✅ Expand Your Daily Vocabulary – Talk about your hobbies, routines, and plans.
→ Exercise: “A Day in My Life” – Describe your daily routine using simple present and future tenses.

✅ Handle Everyday Situations – Learn to order food, ask for directions, and shop with confidence.
→ Exercise: Role-play ordering in a café or asking for help in a store.

✅ Improve Your Listening – Understand slow, clear speech in real-life contexts.
→ Exercise: Listen to short dialogues and answer simple questions.

pro_course_detail.title: English B1 for Intermediate
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 B1 – Speak with More Freedom & Accuracy
If you already manage basic conversations but want to speak more naturally, this level is for you!

✅ Communicate Your Ideas Clearly – Express opinions, describe experiences, and tell simple stories.
→ Exercise: “Tell Me About Your Last Holiday” – Practice using the past simple and past continuous.

✅ Master Social Conversations – Engage in friendly small talk and express likes/dislikes.
→ Exercise: Role-play a casual conversation with a friend or coworker.

✅ Strengthen Your Listening & Grammar – Learn to recognize key phrases and improve sentence structure.
→ Exercise: Listen to a short podcast and summarize the main ideas.

pro_course_detail.title: English B2 for High Intermediate
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 B2 – Speak Fluently & Express Yourself Naturally
For independent speakers who want to sound more confident and precise in discussions and everyday life.

✅ Debate & Discuss – Learn how to defend your opinions and participate in engaging conversations.
→ Exercise: “Agree or Disagree” – Express your opinion on different topics using persuasive language.

✅ Boost Your Vocabulary – Discover idioms, phrasal verbs, and natural expressions.
→ Exercise: Fun quiz on common idioms and their meanings.

✅ Understand More Complex Audio & Texts – Improve comprehension with real-world materials.
→ Exercise: Analyze a short news article and discuss key points.

pro_course_detail.title: English C1 for Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 C1 – Speak Like a Pro with Advanced Skills
Take your English to the next level with natural, nuanced communication.

✅ Master Complex Conversations – Express ideas fluently in both formal and informal situations.
→ Exercise: “Problem-Solving Discussion” – Work through a real-world challenge with structured conversation techniques.

✅ Sound More Native – Perfect your pronunciation, intonation, and word choice.
→ Exercise: Imitate native speech patterns and receive personalized feedback.

✅ Work with Advanced Texts & Audio – Understand fast-paced conversations and abstract ideas.
→ Exercise: Watch a TED Talk and summarize the main arguments.

pro_course_detail.title: English C2 for Very Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
🔹 C2 – Achieve True Fluency & Native-Like Mastery
At this level, it’s all about refining your skills and sounding as natural as possible.

✅ Master Subtle Nuances – Learn advanced collocations, idioms, and cultural expressions.
→ Exercise: “Say It Like a Native” – Replace common phrases with more sophisticated alternatives.

✅ Speak Without Hesitation – Improve flow and natural rhythm in conversations.
→ Exercise: Debate a thought-provoking topic with near-native fluency.

✅ Analyze & Create Complex Texts – Develop academic and professional writing skills.
→ Exercise: Write a persuasive essay or analyze a complex literary text.

edu_info.description: IELTS (International English Language Testing System) es un examen de inglés que evalúa la capacidad lingüística de hablantes no nativos. Otorgado por el consulado Británico con ayuda de la universidad de Cambridge.

La carrera de Administración en Ecoturismo se enfoca en el desarrollo de territorios a través del turismo sustentable y el ecoturismo. La carrera combina conocimientos teóricos y prácticos, y busca aportar a las comunidades locales, especialmente las remotas y vinculadas a áreas protegidas.  Los administradores en ecoturismo pueden trabajar en el sector público o privado, en lugares como municipalidades, el Servicio Nacional de Turismo (SERNATUR), la CONAF, el INE, INJUV, entre otros.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish for begginers with a Native!
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you starting your journey to learn Spanish? Don’t worry, I can help you!

This class is designed for absolute beginners or those with little experience in Spanish. We will start from the basics and build a strong foundation step by step.

What to Expect:
- Learn essential greetings, phrases, and vocabulary for everyday situations
- Master over 1,000 essential words to help you communicate effectively in Spanish
- Fun and interactive activities to practice speaking and listening
- Cultural tips to enrich your learning experience and make it more authentic

Learning with a native Spanish speaker gives you the advantage of acquiring natural pronunciation, real-life expressions, and cultural insights that go beyond textbooks. You'll be exposed to authentic speech and idiomatic phrases that will help you sound more fluent and confident.

I focus on creating a comfortable and encouraging environment so you feel confident and motivated to learn. No prior knowledge is needed—just a willingness to try!

pro_course_detail.title: Español para viajeros: Modismos en español
pro_course_detail.description:
¿Planeas visitar América Latina o España? Esta clase está diseñada para ayudarte a disfrutar tu viaje con facilidad mientras comprendes las expresiones únicas y los matices culturales de cada país.

Qué aprenderás:
    - Frases esenciales para viajar: preguntar direcciones, pedir comida, registrarte en hoteles y más.
    - Vocabulario clave para transporte, compras y emergencias.
    - Diferencias regionales: descubre cómo varía el español entre países, desde el mexicano "¿Qué onda?" hasta el argentino "Che" y el español "Vale".
    - Consejos culturales para conectar con los locales y entender sus tradiciones.

Esta clase interactiva y práctica te preparará para situaciones reales, asegurando que disfrutes tu viaje al máximo. ¡Vamos a aprender!

pro_course_detail.title: Español conversacional ¡y entretenido!
pro_course_detail.description:
¿Quieres ganar confianza al hablar español y mejorar tu fluidez? Mis clases de español conversacional están diseñadas para ayudarte a expresarte de manera natural y cómoda en situaciones reales.

¿Qué veremos en clase?
    - Conversaciones guiadas: Práctica de temas cotidianos como viajes, comida, trabajo, cultura y más.
    - Vocabulario y expresiones: Aprende frases útiles para enriquecer tus conversaciones.
    - Corrección y retroalimentación: Mejoraremos tu pronunciación, gramática y estructura de oraciones mientras hablas.
    - Diferencias culturales: Descubre cómo se comunica en diferentes países hispanohablantes.

Actividades entretenidas:
    - Debates sobre temas actuales o de tu interés.
    - Storytelling: cuenta historias, describe experiencias o inventa escenarios.
    - ¡Sesiones de preguntas y respuestas para que puedas practicar espontáneamente!

Aprender con un hablante nativo de español te da la ventaja de adquirir una pronunciación natural, expresiones reales y conocimientos culturales que van más allá de los libros de texto. Estarás expuesto a un habla auténtica y frases idiomáticas que te ayudarán a sonar más fluido y seguro.

Mi objetivo es que disfrutes aprendiendo mientras hablas. Sin presiones, con paciencia y adaptando las clases a tus intereses. ¡Prepárate para hablar como un nativo!

pro_course_detail.title: Ingles para principiantes ¡en español!
pro_course_detail.description:
Aprende inglés desde cero y abre nuevas oportunidades

¿Estás dando tus primeros pasos en el aprendizaje del inglés? Estas clases están diseñadas para personas de habla hispana que quieren construir una base sólida en vocabulario, gramática y habilidades esenciales para comunicarse en cualquier situación.

¿Qué aprenderás en clase?
    - Frases básicas para presentarte, saludar y expresar necesidades
    - Pronunciación inicial y lectura de palabras comunes
    - Vocabulario esencial: números, días, colores, comida y más
    - Gramática básica: estructuras simples como sujeto + verbo + objeto

Beneficios de aprender inglés:
    - Aumenta tus oportunidades laborales y accede a mejores empleos
    - Facilita tu vida si planeas viajar o vivir en el extranjero
    - Mejora tu confianza para comunicarte con personas de todo el mundo

Metodología divertida y efectiva:
    - Canciones y videos para aprender frases comunes
    - Ejercicios visuales para conectar imágenes con palabras
    - Clases 100% en español para que aprendas con seguridad

Empieza hoy y descubre cómo el inglés puede transformar tu futuro. ¡Demos este primer paso juntos!

pro_course_detail.title: Ingles conversacional ¡en español!
pro_course_detail.description:
Inglés Conversacional para Principiantes: Gana Confianza al Hablar 

¿Quieres empezar a hablar inglés pero aún no te sientes seguro? Esta clase está diseñada para hispanohablantes que desean practicar conversación en un ambiente relajado y guiado, sin miedo a equivocarse.

¿Qué trabajaremos en clase?
- Construcción de frases básicas para expresarte con naturalidad.
- Práctica de situaciones cotidianas como presentaciones, compras o pedir direcciones.
- Técnicas para mejorar la pronunciación y ganar fluidez poco a poco.
- Expresiones comunes y trucos para entender mejor a los hablantes nativos.

    Un espacio seguro para practicar
Sabemos que hablar en otro idioma puede dar nervios, por eso aquí practicamos sin presiones, con apoyo y correcciones amigables. Además, las explicaciones se pueden hacer en español para facilitar el aprendizaje.
